posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Yeah, the red is a bit garish for my taste, but what the heck, at least it's different.  I am however a bit disappointed that the villain decks look so similar to the hero decks, and don't have the kind of unique variation among them of previous villains (particularly in the core sets - Omnitron and Baron Blade are things of beauty, and Citizen Dawn is epically cool).  The vague resemblance between the RC and IR decks is something of a nuisance to me, but what really gets my goat is the way Scholar and Unity look like they come from the core set.  Vengeance having 10 of its 12 decks be distinguished only by a name logo is somewhat less than optimal.

Oh well, it's a mega-expansion with five heroes, and what can be classified either as one villain with a lot of permutations or 16 villains with a lot of similarities.  I can't complain too much about mere aesthetics.
